scheduled.timezone_note: Offsets compare nominal UTC cron with run.created_at UTC on same observed date; NOT dispatch or queue latency

snapshot_join.frozen_531_to_current: Retain original failed-run source; zero current failures is not historical zero

governance.interpretation: No verified enforced server-side PR/CI admission gate; observed successful PR reviews are procedural. Do not attempt admin changes from this review

external_objects.workflowhub: Official publicly indexed version 2 page, WIP, CWL v1.2 with tests-passing marker; not independent scientific replication

limitations: Normalized fields derived from live repository API, not raw HTTP archive or permanent Github all-time census
No access to unrelated branches, deleted workflow logs, external institutional private account status, or biological truth
No new native scheduled-run acceptance since 2026-10-26
